== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Oversight, also known as Outpost 01, is a central location situated at the nexus of all existence within [[Way|the Way]]. Located at the north pole of [[Makiel]]'s home planet, it serves as a vital hub for monitoring the multiverse. From this position, highly skilled [[Hounds]] can observe the destinies of every [[Iteration]] and track threads of [[Fate]] across hundreds of different worlds. This capability allows them to identify criminals, predict upcoming disasters, and investigate instances where the fates of different [[Iterations]] overlap. The facility's primary purpose is to provide a clear view of existence, facilitating the observation and preservation of order throughout the various worlds.}}
